title: Per-row helper function in a policy
issue: A policy that calls a PL/pgSQL or SECURITY DEFINER helper with a row column cannot be inlined or hoisted; it runs once per row.
symptom: naive_rls shows a Seq Scan with Filter: app.is_member_plpgsql(org_id) and a huge Rows Removed by Filter; time scales with table size.

scale.meaning: number of rows in app.documents (100 docs per org, scale/20 users)
